LanguageData.ZamioculcasZamiifolia.description: "Money Tree" Caladium is a point-to-point alchemist who became the wealthiest merchant in the Rat Kingdom through shady dealings. She runs her colony like a corporation and cares little for anything other than generating wealth; rising wealth value is her only metric. Her story frequently generates massive amounts of wealth for you—a blessing, yet also a curse, since she never considers whether you can fully utilize this wealth.
LanguageData.ZamioculcasZamiifolia.label: "Money Tree" Caladium
